fields.statement: QA with the branch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a scratch root and repo, hermetic HOME: started a run on a wait-step workflow, committed leaf alpha in the run worktree with verifier Evidence; rhiza run code-check passed. Then ran rhiza docs, appended a stray line to docs/reference/cli.md and wrote a README naming `rhiza no-such-command`: plain rhiza check failed with 'fail render docs/reference/cli.md: differs from what rhiza docs writes' and 'fail docs-command README.md', exit 1; rhiza check --skip-reference was ok, exit 0, and printed the same bytes as rhiza api call check '{"skip_reference":true}'; rhiza run code-check still passed with neither among its causes. A stale .rhiza/rendered/index.md still failed code-check with the render cause. go test ./internal/api -run TestCheck and TestScripts/review-code-check and describe-golden pass.
